PART I

Item 1. Financial Statements

The unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements of the company for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2023 are presented herein. These interim financial statements have been prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles for interim financial information. In the opinion of management, all adjustments necessary for a fair presentation of the financial position and results of operations have been included. The results for the three months ended September 30, 2023 are not necessarily indicative of the results to be expected for the full fiscal year. These financial statements should be read in conjunction with the audited financial statements included in the company's most recent Annual Report.

Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis

The following discussion and analysis should be read in conjunction with the condensed consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this quarterly report on Form 10-Q. Revenue for the third quarter of 2023 was $312 million, an increase of 11% compared to the third quarter of 2022. The increase was primarily attributable to growth in the recurring subscription revenue base. Operating income was $52 million compared to $44 million in the prior year period representing an operating margin of approximately 16.7%. The company continues to invest in product development and sales infrastructure.

Item 3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

There have been no material changes to the quantitative and qualitative disclosures about market risk from those reported in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. The company's exposure to interest rate risk, foreign currency exchange rate risk, and equity price risk remain substantially consistent with the disclosures provided in the most recent annual filing. The company continues to monitor market conditions and will update its risk disclosures in future filings as circumstances warrant.

Item 4. Controls and Procedures

Disclosure Controls and Procedures. The company's management, with the participation of the Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, evaluated the effectiveness of the company's disclosure controls and procedures as of September 30, 2023. Based on this evaluation, management concluded that the company's disclosure controls and procedures were effective as of that date. Changes in Internal Controls. There were no changes in the company's internal control over financial reporting during the quarter that materially affected or are reasonably likely to materially affect the company's internal control over financial reporting.

PART II

Item 1. Legal Proceedings

The company is a party to certain legal proceedings in the ordinary course of its business. The company does not believe that any of these proceedings will have a material adverse effect on its financial condition or results of operations. The company maintains insurance coverage that it believes is adequate for the risks it faces in its business operations. All material pending legal proceedings are described in the notes to the financial statements included elsewhere in this quarterly report on Form 10-Q. Management evaluates these matters regularly.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

There have been no material changes to the risk factors previously disclosed in the company's Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022 except as noted below. The company has identified additional risks related to macroeconomic conditions including potential recessionary pressures, elevated inflation, and tightening financial conditions which could negatively affect customer spending on data and analytics services. These risks are in addition to those previously identified and should be read together with those disclosures.

Item 2. Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities

During the quarter ended September 30, 2023 the company did not sell any equity securities that were not registered under the Securities Act of 1933. The company repurchased approximately 500,000 shares of its common stock during the quarter at an average price of $42.50 per share under the share repurchase program authorized by the Board of Directors. Approximately $125 million remains available under the current repurchase authorization which expires in December 2024. Repurchases are made in the open market or through privately negotiated transactions.

Item 3. Defaults Upon Senior Securities

None. The company is not in default with respect to any of its outstanding debt obligations or other senior securities. All interest payments on the company's outstanding notes have been made on a timely basis in accordance with the respective indenture agreements. The company is in compliance with all financial covenants contained in its credit agreement and note indentures as of September 30, 2023, and management does not anticipate any covenant violations in the foreseeable future based on current financial projections and business outlook.

Item 4. Mine Safety Disclosures

Not applicable. The company does not operate any coal or other mines subject to the Federal Mine Safety and Health Act of 1977. This disclosure item is included for completeness per the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 as amended by the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act. The company's business operations do not involve any activities regulated under the Mine Safety and Health Administration rules or regulations.

Item 5. Other Information

None. There is no other information required to be disclosed in a report on Form 8-Current during the quarter ended September 30, 2023 that has not been previously reported. The company has evaluated all events and transactions that occurred through the date of this filing and determined that no additional disclosures are required beyond those already included in this quarterly report on Form 10-Q. The company's officers certify to the accuracy of this report pursuant to Section 302 and Section 906 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002.
